_comment: Edit prices here — the quote tool, services page and receipts all read from this file. Restart `npm run dev` after changing it. fees.perItem is charged for every uploaded item. vans.hireFee is fixed; fuel uses vans.mpg and fees.dieselPricePerLitre.
